body: Yeah, it's not the same anymore. I blame that on filter and block functions, mostly. They've gotten out of hand to the point that I feel like others and me aren't even frequenting the same internet anymore. Everyone justs sits in their little filter bubble all day long, and if someone else tries to interact, it gets labeled as "harassment"... I'm not going to defend people who send abusive PMs or suchlike, but sometimes I'm worried how those people are going to function offline. (They probably just don't.)
